items.name: green pear (whole)
items.preparation: raw, whole, unpeeled; edible mass excludes core and stem

scale_cues: Square white plate assumed about 24-26 cm across; individual almond size (~2.2 cm long, ~1.2 g each, roughly 45-50 counted) and grape diameter (~2 cm, ~5-6 g each, roughly 17-18 counted) used to cross-check; pear appears ~7-8 cm wide relative to the grapes and almonds.
assumptions: Almonds are plain (raw or dry-roasted) with no added oil or salt
Almond pile is mostly a single layer with some overlap; count estimated at about 45-50 nuts
Grapes are seedless, about 17-18 pieces at 5-6 g each
Pear is small-to-medium; edible mass is taken as about 90% of whole weight (core and stem excluded)
No sauces, dressings, oils or drinks are visible
